set.body: Add CpcaConstraintSpec and CpcaEstimatorSpec-style planning values so MultivarEstimator can carry row and column constraints before ROI-local MvSpace values exist. Acceptance: Identity, Zero, and Basis design specs are shape-checkable; specs do not depend on dataset, formula, or scheduler types; resolved CpcaConstraint remains the algebra-level projector type.
set.title: CPCA: unresolved constraint and estimator specs
